title: BIP-328
definition: BIP-328 is a Bitcoin Improvement Proposal defining the Hierarchical Deterministic Keys (HD Keys) using the Silent Payments-related and descriptor key formats for derivation, standardising how extended keys and key origins are encoded. It supports the unambiguous representation of key paths and fingerprints used by descriptor-based and Taproot-aware wallets. By standardising key encoding, it improves interoperability between wallets handling Taproot assets and multi-party setups.
